title: Redeem preview rounds the payout down to zero for small positions

root_cause.description: previewRedeem() truncates the assets-per-share division before multiplying, so a small holder's previewed payout is zero while redeem() pays the untruncated amount
root_cause.mechanism: the preview divides then multiplies, losing the fractional part the settle path keeps

evidence.description: the quantified payout delta carried by the registered report
